displayDescription: A radar sweep finds an idea on pass 1 and a connected system on pass 2, then links the two findings.
styleRenderer: SVG (inline vector layers, mask, clipPath, stroke-dashoffset)
audioDescription: Silent preview; no music, effects or narration.
limitations: Illustrative reconstruction: radar returns and evidence points are seeded procedural vectors, not measured data or real footage.
The radar sweep is a flat 2D SVG approximation of an instrument display. It has no physical phosphor decay; the afterglow is approximated with stepped-opacity wedge slices.

STYLE.json contains no tech.preview_recipes and there is no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json, so no optional recipe or source-frame evidence was applied. The preview demonstrates the primary characteristic action (two successive radar passes, then their relationship).
Blender was not used, per instruction. GSAP is loaded from the project-local gsap.min.js.
